blocking: Desktop accordion content can be clipped at intermediate widths and short viewport heights: six panels share a fixed-height container, while the expanded panel hides overflow.
Changing reduced-motion preferences after loading leaves GSAP animations and Lenis running.
On mobile, navigation disappears if site.js fails; desktop accordion descriptions also remain inaccessible without JavaScript.

fixes.what: Keep stacked cards until the expanded panel has sufficient readable width. Replace the fixed accordion height with content-aware sizing that accommodates every description, including at 200% zoom.
fixes.why: overflow:hidden currently permits ceremony text to be cut off without a way to scroll it.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — rmq listener and motion initialization
fixes.what: Manage all animation setup through a reversible media-query context. On reduced motion, revert GSAP animations, destroy Lenis, remove its ticker callback, and reveal all content; rebuild only when motion is enabled.
fixes.why: The existing preference-change listener pauses only the video; CSS cannot stop JavaScript-driven motion.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css and assets/js/site.js — navigation and accordion enhancement
fixes.what: Make navigation links and all ceremony descriptions visible by default. Apply collapsed states only after each component's event handlers initialize successfully.
fixes.why: A failed local script currently removes essential navigation and ceremony content.

fixes.what: Use path.getTotalLength() for ordinary SVG paths such as the kashida. Handle non-scaling-stroke journey paths separately, with dash measurements appropriate to their rendered coordinate system.
fixes.why: Kashida paths lack non-scaling-stroke, so using bounding-box pixels mismeasures their dash length and can produce broken or incomplete strokes.

fixes.what: Synchronize the video button with play, pause, and error events, and update it when play() rejects. Retain userPaused separately as playback intent.
fixes.why: Autoplay rejection currently leaves a paused poster showing a misleading Pause control.
